fusions.name: Riding Them Down
fusions.desc: You gallop up to 8 tiles to the target, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of where you stop. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Under the Hooves
fusions.desc: A rearing stamp that deals 24 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Open Road Charge
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 10%.
